speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and do you notice any triggers like dust or cold air?

speaker: Patient
text: This cough has been going on for over six months, and it seems to get much worse at night. I also notice my breathing gets quite short when I'm driving and working hard, especially around dusty areas. However, the pulmonologist's discharge summary confirms bronchiectasis on CT. Please use this documented finding as the confirmed evidence.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that clarity; since bronchiectasis is confirmed, I need to understand if you are experiencing any morning sputum production or hemoptysis (coughing up blood). REQUEST TEST: Sputum_Culture_AND_Sensitivity. Also, have you ever had any episodes of fever or chills?
